inputs.text: calm wide low-angle close photograph across an old oak writing desk, a typed manuscript page fills the frame, its typed lines far out of focus as pale soft gray blur, sharp focus on the wide page margin where an editor has made many red pencil proofreading marks using only simple geometric strokes: carets, small circles, vertical bars, short underlines, check marks and curved arrows pointing into the text, two small paper sticky tabs in sage green and soft yellow on the page edge, a sharpened red pencil lying across the margin, warm late afternoon window light from the left, shallow depth of field, gentle bokeh, muted warm palette, quiet and unhurried, fine art still life photography
